$schema_note: Deterministic structure of a NEW-SYSTEM (data-mx) Deep Dive. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH — consumed by validate-chapter-plan.py (mx-special checks, WP-6) and scripts/stitch_specials.py. Chrome (masthead, cover, act openers, transit seams, chapter plates, footer) is stitcher-owned and writer-unrepresentable. Spec: design-system-unification SPEC Part 1, Part 7 §3 (Deep Dive = The Argument + Keep Digging), WP-6.

law2.planned_density_note: Same reachability model as season-review.json: est_screens_390 = words/250 + 0.5 x total_planned_events (writer events + stitcher structural: plates = n_chapters, act openers = n_acts, transits = n_acts - 1); reject when total/est < law2.floor. Rendered gates remain ground truth.

acts.note: Editorial-skin arc in ink terms: paper-white -> parchment/sepia tints (Law 4/11). issue_meta.acts as in season-review.json; palettes from a dossier motif pack or per-act tokens.

timing.note: Deep Dives are undated subjects — no event/period timing gate.

signature_moment.note: tier0 print-still: hairline draw-ins + ghost-numeral parallax are auto-targeted by mx-motion.js; no per-chapter signature class is stamped.

cover.gesture: oversized ghosted numeral or map fragment (Law 7); editorial cover, not the event poster

chrome.note: Stitcher-owned: one .mx-mast, cover, .mx-actopen per act, .mx-transit per seam, one .mx-plate per chapter, back pill, .mx-footer. Structural events at plan time: n_chapters + n_acts + (n_acts - 1).

slots.notes: Orientation: what this dive is, why now, the map of the terrain — dossier index-card ledger.

The body chapters (typically 4-9). Long-form prose with dossier objects: index cards, telegram slips, map fragments, framed figures, quote objects (Law 9: >=5 named voices across the issue; historians/primary sources count).
THE KILLER FEATURE (Part 7 §3): the magazine's own position, ANALYZED lane, working shown — not a summary. Validator rejects a Deep Dive plan without it.
THE KILLER FEATURE (Part 7 §3): the onward-reading/watching trailhead as cheat-sheet furniture (books, sources, one wildcard).

killer_features.desc: Keep Digging renders as cheat-sheet furniture.
